items.rule: 具体到某一天用 on，只有月份或年份用 in。
上午下午晚上用 in the morning，夜里用 at night。

items.point: 地点用 at 还是 in
items.rule: 把地点当成一个点用 at，把它当成一个空间范围用 in。
items.wrong: I met him in the station.
items.right: I met him at the station.

items.rule: go home、arrive home 是固定搭配，home 前不加 to。
items.wrong: I go to home after class.

items.point: 交通方式 by 与 on
items.rule: by + 交通工具（by bike），但 on foot 是固定说法。
items.wrong: I go to work by my bike.
items.right: I go to work by bike.

items.rule: for 接一段时间，since 接时间点。
items.wrong: I have studied English since five years.
items.right: I have studied English for five years.

items.rule: 表示从外到里的移动用 into。
because of + 名词，because + 句子。
items.wrong: The match was cancelled because the rain.
items.right: The match was cancelled because of the rain.

items.rule: 书、谈话的主题用 about 或 on。
items.wrong: This is a book in history.
items.right: This is a book about history.

items.rule: 贴在表面上用 on，嵌在墙里才用 in。
items.wrong: There is a picture in the wall.
items.right: There is a picture on the wall.

items.rule: 两者之间用 between，三者及以上用 among。
items.wrong: Divide it between the three groups.
items.right: Divide it among the three groups.

items.rule: arrive at 小地点，arrive in 大地点，不用 arrive to。
items.wrong: We arrived to the hotel at nine.
items.right: We arrived at the hotel at nine.

items.rule: 对某事感兴趣用 be interested in。
擅长用 be good at + 名词或动名词。
害怕某物用 be afraid of。
